'''Harro Kelpura''' was an [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served as a [[Lore Seeker|scholar]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was investigating an [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that had been discovered near [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier. Kelpura responded to a break-in at his research [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] with the pod's former occupant, [[Nuru Kungurama]], but their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crashed during the investigation, knocking Kelpura unconscious. Soon after, he was brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] medical center.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Change course ''now.'' Two ships have landed without authorization on my lab building's roof, and the alarm system has been disabled. Someone must be trying to steal the pod!|Harro Kelpura, to Nuru Kungurama|<ref name="SM4" />}}
[[File:NuruKungurama-SA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Chiss Nuru Kungurama had occupied the alien escape pod that Harro Kelpura was assigned to investigate.]]
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Harro Kelpura of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was an [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lore Seeker|scholar]] who was enthusiastic about his work in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SM4" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Kelpura was investigating an exotic [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that had been discovered [[33 BBY/Legends|eleven years earlier]] near [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], and had contained the Chiss boy [[Nuru Kungurama]]. Kelpura soon moved the Chiss pod to a research [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] in Coruscant's [[Dacho District]], away from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], as a safety precaution.<ref name="SM4" /> 

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ERC" /> Kungurama, who had become a Jedi and was leading the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] [[Breakout Squad]] on a series of missions, was told by Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] that Kelpura wanted to speak with him regarding discoveries related to the Chiss pod once Kungurama returned to Coruscant. Meanwhile, fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] used Kelpura's claim that the scholar had deciphered data about the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] civilization that had made the pod to convert Kungrama's Master [[Ring-Sol Ambase]], who knew Kelpura well, to ally with him. While Kelpura discussed his research with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant, Kungurama and his squad arrived and Kelpura introduced himself to them. After Kelpura explained his research and urged them to come see the Chiss pod, Kungurama agreed to visit it at the suggestion of Palpatine.<ref name="SM4" /> 

Kelpura departed with the group for the Jedi Temple aboard Kungurama's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], intending to visit the scholar's lab in the Dacho District afterward. En route, Kelpura received a notification that his lab had been broken into, so the group's freighter changed course to divert there instead. Upon arrival, the group saw that a [[Corona-class transport|''Corona''-class transport]] used by Kungurama's missing Master had gotten there first. Kungurama's freighter then crashed after impacting with a [[Sleight of Hand|dropship]] that belonged to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was assisting the missing Ambase. Kelpura was knocked unconscious in the crash, while Kungurama went to [[Skirmish at Moxonnic Manufacturing|confront]] his Master. After the confrontation ended, Kelpura and Ambase were sent to the Jedi Temple medical center. [[Standard day/Legends|Days]] later, Kungurama visited both Jedi Masters, who were feeling much better.<ref name="SM4" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I was distressed when I learned you left Coruscant, young one. I am glad you returned safely.|Kelpura, to Kungurama|<ref name="SM4" />}}
Master Kelpura was eager to perform his research work and excited to show his discoveries to the escape pod's original occupant, Nuru Kungurama. Prior to meeting Kungurama, Kelpura was concerned for him when he left Coruscant, and expressed that he was glad Kungurama returned when they finally met. Upon receiving the notification about the laboratory break-in, he insisted Breakout Squad change course to investigate with extreme urgency. He spoke with a low, rumbling voice.<ref name="SM4" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|A Jedi scholar, Harro Kelpura, has been studying an unusual spacecraft and claims he has successfully deciphered extensive data about the civilization that produced the craft. Most of the data is related to the military offensive and defensive systems.|Count Dooku to Ring-Sol Ambase, on Kelpura|<ref name="SM4" />}}
A gifted scholar, Kelpura deciphered data on the Chiss's military defensive and offensive systems from studying a Chiss escape pod.<ref name="SM4" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|What’s this? Must be some kind of technical error.|Kelpura, while reading data about his Coruscant lab on his datapad|<ref name="SM4" />}}
Kelpura wore a small square [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] on a [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="SM4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harro Kelpura appeared in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2012]] young readers novel, [[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key|''Guardians of the Chiss Key'']], the fourth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.<ref name="SM4" />
